CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_scope_requests (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 project_id INTEGER REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
 detail TEXT,
 estimated_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
 requested_on DATE NOT NULL,
 decision VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 decision_note TEXT,
 decided_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_scope_requests_title CHECK (length(btrim(title)) > 0),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_scope_requests_minutes CHECK (estimated_minutes > 0 AND estimated_minutes <= 60000),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_scope_requests_decision CHECK (decision IN ('pending','absorb','bill','swap')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_scope_requests_decided CHECK ((decision = 'pending') = (decided_at IS NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_client_scope_requests_client_requested ON client_scope_requests (client_id, requested_on)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_client_scope_requests_project_id ON client_scope_requests (project_id)
